name: Sena Hiyori
source:
[i]"They say if you appear on stream, your wish is granted!"[/i]

A sophomore at Gekkei High School. Tomose Banjo is her childhood friend. She is always trying her best at everything she does. Just before summer break, her and Banjo meet a strange man and were suddenly transported into the Other World Stream.

[From [url=http://ideafintl.com/charade-maniacs/chara/?page=ch0]Idea Factory International[/url]]
